frequency_question: How often does a joint resolution of disapproval successfully pass both chambers and defeat a presidential veto or prevent entry into force within the allotted statutory calendar days?
membership_rule: Includes all formal 123 agreements submitted to Congress where a joint resolution of disapproval was introduced and reached floor consideration within the statutory review period. Excludes informal consultations or agreements not formally submitted under the Atomic Energy Act.

cases.name: Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action (JCPOA) related nuclear accord review period

provenance_note: claims 30 cases from only 4 named (7.5x); beyond 3.0x the skeleton is not carrying the estimate
coverage_note: 4 major contested or notable cases listed explicitly; universe contains roughly 30 routine or non-controversial 123 agreements none of which were successfully blocked by joint resolution.
known_gaps: Exact count of minor technical 123 agreement modifications omitted, but none resulted in successful joint resolutions of disapproval.
skeleton: Total formal 123 agreement submissions over 50 years (approx 30) divided into those where resolutions of disapproval cleared both chambers and survived/overrode veto (0).
multiplier: 0 successful congressional blocks via joint resolution out of ~30 submitted formal 123 agreements.
validity_reason: Statutory frameworks under the Atomic Energy Act regarding congressional review periods remain stable over multi-decadal horizons.
